notes.note: Reviewed supervised startup, the READY IPC transition and the launcher HTTP checks. The launcher first observes the expected HTTP boot identity, then confirms the same active generation before and after a fresh authenticated HTTP read. Generation IDs and IPC boot IDs remain distinct from the inherited HTTP launch identity. A draining generation can expose matching health and is not admitted. Executed the negative fixture, full local process and CLI owner suites, and merged-source regression. Windows package evidence remains the historical failure, not candidate qualification.

Reviewed the changed startup readiness join, the supervision and direct-launch boundary, the hosted exact-Host identity request, and startup cleanup. The supervised path extends the evidence required inside the existing waits, with no new startup budget. Existing listener/boot validation, owner process record, update and handoff, auth, proxy scopes, and direct-start behavior retain their original owners. Executed CLI typecheck, 311 focused lifecycle and supervisor tests and the merged-source real-process check.
